story.title: The Projector Claim

creativeDirection.dramaticPremise: Two flatmates wrestle for their shared projector until the India-Zimbabwe first T20I streaming guide fails to provide the details needed to justify reserving it.

dramaticSpine.characterGoal: Asha wants to reserve the projector immediately for the India versus Zimbabwe first T20I live stream.
dramaticSpine.obstacle: Dev needs the projector for film night and refuses to surrender it without a confirmed start time and streaming platform.
dramaticSpine.newsCatalyst: A guide names the India versus Zimbabwe first T20I live streaming, pitch report and Harare weather as its subjects.
dramaticSpine.reversal: The supplied material provides no actual streaming time or platform, leaving Asha unable to prove when she needs the projector.
dramaticSpine.costOfFailure: Asha must delay her match invitation and give up the projector claim for now.
dramaticSpine.emotionalTurn: Her confident takeover becomes an embarrassed but practical retreat.
dramaticSpine.resolution: Asha returns the cable to Dev and waits for the missing viewing details before inviting anyone.

visualBible.storyArc: A playful projector tug-of-war escalates into a countdown, collapses when the viewing details are absent, and ends with a reluctant handover.

lines.speaker: asha
lines.text: India versus Zimbabwe, first T20I—I'm claiming the projector for the live stream.

lines.text: You are claiming my film-night screen with no start time?

lines.speaker: asha
lines.text: The guide should tell me when and where to watch. Hand over HDMI.

lines.speaker: dev
lines.text: Name the platform, and I surrender. Three... two...

beats.dramaticAction: Asha abruptly stops pulling, checks the supplied page and accidentally lets the cable recoil into Dev's hands.

lines.speaker: asha
lines.text: Wait. This supplied page only names live streaming, pitch report and Harare weather.

lines.text: No actual time or platform here. Cable stays.

beats.dramaticAction: Asha lowers the projector, closes her unfinished invitation on the phone and pushes one snack bowl towards Dev.
beats.turningPoint: She abandons the group screening plan for now, allowing Dev's film night to proceed.

lines.text: Fine—I'm releasing the projector, not the match. I'll stop the invites.

lines.text: Verify first. My film night keeps its screen.
